_readme: The village chooser. status 'ready' opens the walk in folder; 'soon' shows a Coming soon card. Text in [[c:...]] is cyan (not confirmed). status 'draft' shows only with draft colours on. status 'suggest' is the suggest-a-village card (opens an email).

villages.name: Warmington
villages.teaser: [[c:A mystery walk around the village, starting and finishing at the Red Lion.]]
villages.details: [[c:About 1 hr 30 to 2 hr 30, depending on your pace.]]

villages.name: Elton
villages.teaser: [[c:Lanes, a riverside mill and a Saxon church, starting and finishing at the Crown Inn.]]

villages.name: Oundle
villages.teaser: [[c:Inns, a famous school, a soaring spire and the River Nene. Short or long walk.]]

villages.name: Fotheringhay
villages.teaser: [[c:A tiny village with a royal past: Richard III's birthplace and the castle where Mary, Queen of Scots, died.]]

villages.name: Nassington
villages.teaser: [[c:A royal hall, King Cnut's chess and the oldest house in the county.]]

villages.name: Barnwell
villages.teaser: [[c:A 13th-century castle, two churches and almshouses from 1601.]]

villages.name: Polebrook
villages.teaser: [[c:A quiet village next to a busy American bomber base in the Second World War.]]

villages.name: Wansford
villages.teaser: [[c:An old stone bridge, the Great North Road and the famous haycock legend.]]

villages.name: Suggest a village
villages.teaser: [[c:Where would you like a From Sparks walk next? Tell us and we'll take a look.]]

sections.heading: [[c:About]]
text: [[c:From Sparks Adventures makes self-guided mystery walks around local villages. Walk at your own pace, solve the puzzles and learn a little local history on the way.]]

sections.heading: [[c:Stay safe]]
text: [[c:Take care near roads and keep to pavements, public footpaths and open spaces.]]
[[c:Children should be with an adult. Look at buildings from the road: please don't go into private property or gardens.]]
[[c:Be kind to the people who live here: keep noise down, take litter home and leave gates as you find them.]]

sections.heading: [[c:Your privacy]]
text: [[c:There are no accounts. Your progress, settings and any unlock are saved only on your phone, in this browser.]]
[[c:If you switch on location, it is used on your phone to show where you are and is never sent to us or anyone else.]]
[[c:The directions buttons open Google Maps, which has its own privacy policy.]]
